features:
🛠️ After the long wait.. JJS Auto Builder v2 Released!

What's New:

✅ 100% Mobile Compatibility
Fully support for mobile devices.

⚡ 30% Faster Building
Build speed increased by 30%.

🗺️ New Map Stealer Feature
Easily copy any map created by other players!

After pressing the "Steal" button, the script will scan and save the map data.

Once stealing is complete, go to the "Build" tab, click "List" to view saved files.

Select a file, click "Load from File", then press "Build" to build it!

🌍 Multi-Language Support
Now supports 13 new languages — making it easier for users around the world.
